stories.headline: This robot picks things up faster than a human—and investors just bet $1.45B on it
stories.blurb: Eka Robotics built a gripper and AI model that picks up 1,500 objects per hour (humans do ~600) with 95%+ reliability. The robot moves so fast it could hurt itself, which means the AI is confident enough to work at dangerous speeds. Veteran roboticists call it a 'wow factor' breakthrough—one compared the emotional impact to when robots first learned to walk reliably.
stories.why_it_matters: Picking things up has been robotics' hardest problem; this is the first system that looks like it actually solved it.
stories.original_headline: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving

stories.headline: Perplexity's agent can now run entirely on your Mac, no internet needed
stories.blurb: Perplexity Pro subscribers can now run the Computer agent fully offline on Apple silicon Macs. The local mode handles planning, reasoning, and file tasks on-device—reading messages and emails, finding deadlines, creating notes—without sending data to the cloud unless you explicitly approve it.
stories.why_it_matters: Privacy-focused AI that works when you're offline, on a plane, or just don't want your files leaving your laptop.
stories.original_headline: Perplexity’s Computer can now run entirely on your Mac, even offline

stories.headline: Yelp's AI can now call restaurants to check wait times for you
stories.blurb: Yelp's new Check for Me feature lets you enter your party size, then sends an AI agent to call the restaurant and text you back with the current wait time. The app is also getting OpenTable integration for booking and can now remember your preferences across chats.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent-to-agent calls are becoming normal—your AI talking to a restaurant's AI to save you a phone call.
stories.original_headline: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant

stories.headline: Salesforce buys AI marketing platform Braze for $5.7 billion
stories.blurb: Salesforce is acquiring Braze, a platform that uses AI to help marketers personalize campaigns and automate customer messaging. The deal gives Salesforce deeper tools for targeting customers across email, push notifications, and in-app messages — all powered by predictive AI that decides when and what to send.
stories.why_it_matters: Salesforce is betting billions that AI-driven marketing automation is the next must-have for enterprise sales teams.
stories.original_headline: Salesforce to Buy Marketing Platform Braze for $5.7 Billion

stories.headline: Ex-OpenAI research chief built a $1.5B startup making AI for factory floors
stories.blurb: Bob McGrew's Arda raised $230 million to build AI assistants that help manufacturing engineers design and reconfigure assembly lines in days instead of months. The software is already running at defense contractor Anduril. McGrew says it does for factory engineers what Claude or Cursor does for programmers.
stories.why_it_matters: AI coding assistants are now jumping from software development to physical production lines.
stories.original_headline: Former OpenAI exec has quietly built $1.5 billion startup, betting AI can revive U.S. manufacturing
